facts.fact: The Select Committee on Security and Justice reports that the 2025-2030 SAPS Strategic Plan commits to digitise internal case and resource management systems; no system is named and no station count is given (report dated 3 June 2026, briefing held 20 May 2026).

note: One governance fact only. The passages give no station count for any record system. Recommendation 6.13 (digital case and docket management in identified pilot stations by 31 March 2027, to reduce lost dockets) is the committee's ask, not a stated deployment, so it is a systems entry and no fact. Technology Management Services is given R3.1 billion for 2026/27, tied to no system.
